REPUBLIC OF KENYA
IN THE CHIEF MAGISTRATE'S COURT AT KISUMU
CHILDREN'S COURT
CHILDREN CASE NO. E118 OF 2025
BETWEEN
AWN ........ PLAINTIFF
AND
DKO ........ DEFENDANT
JUDGMENT
Coram: Hon. L. A. Ombati-Wafula, Principal Magistrate
Delivered on 14th October 2026
1. The Plaintiff, the mother of two minors aged 9 and 6, seeks legal custody, care and control of the children and maintenance of KES 60,000 per month. The Defendant, their father, seeks joint custody.
2. The children's officer's report, filed on 3rd July 2026, records that both children live with the Plaintiff, attend school near her home and are attached to both parents. The report notes that the older child has a learning disability and receives specialised tuition.
3. The best interests of the child are paramount under Article 53(2) of the Constitution. Parental responsibility is shared by both parents unless the court orders otherwise.
4. The Defendant's payslip shows net earnings of KES 142,300 per month. The Plaintiff earns KES 51,000 per month as a nurse.
5. Joint legal custody is granted. Actual custody, care and control is granted to the Plaintiff. The Defendant shall have access on alternate weekends and half of every school holiday.
6. The Defendant shall pay maintenance of KES 40,000 per month and shall meet 70% of school fees and medical expenses, including the specialised tuition.
7. There shall be no order as to costs, this being a family matter.
L. A. OMBATI-WAFULA
PRINCIPAL MAGISTRATE
